about_the_game:
Escape and survive in this supernatural puzzle adventure game where light is your only defense!

Play as a female protagonist that is visiting her grandmother's house where you explore eerie locations, solve escape room-style puzzles, and uncover hidden objects while managing your sanity. Navigate between reality and a twisted ghost dimension while you fend off spirits with your flashlight and unravel the dark history of a cursed town. 

Explore The Witch's Realm

Investigate eerie locations, each hiding secrets and deadly threats:

  • A Haunted House – The last refuge of a good witch… and now a dangerous trap.

  • An Abandoned Town – Shrouded in mystery, filled with remnants of a lost past.

  • A Foggy Graveyard – Where restless spirits linger, guarding hidden truths.

  • A Twisted Swamp – A dark, shifting maze that distorts reality itself.

Classic Escape Room-Style Puzzles

  • Hidden objects

  • Number codes

  • Riddle solving

  • Mazes

Managing Your Sanity

  • The longer you stay in the darkness, the lower your sanity gets

  • Use Safe Zones to increase your sanity 

  • The lower your sanity, the more frequent and aggressive ghostly encounters become

Flashlight Mechanic 

  • Light is your defense against the darkness

  • Shining it on ghosts will temporarily make them flee or stun them

Ghost Dimension

  • An alternate dimension filled with supernatural power

  • Cleanse alters & ritual sites where ghosts use to cross over to the main world 

Are you ready to uncover the truth and escape The Witch’s Realm—or will you become its next lost soul?

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
